issues_detected.description: ethical_reviews describes the consortium's 'ethics pillar' — community-facing focus groups on what data to share publicly and analysis of the legal/regulatory landscape. That is community engagement, not an institutional ethics review; the record's own source_caveats concedes 'No source names an institutional review board, ethics committee approval, or protocol number' for a dataset of retrospective ICU/PICU/NICU records.
issues_detected.recommendation: Record the actual IRB determination (institution, protocol, waiver) covering retrospective extraction at the 14 contributing hospitals; keep the ethics-pillar material in future_use_impacts or data_governance.

issues_detected.description: The dataset includes pediatric and neonatal ICU admissions with direct_collection.is_direct: false, yet human_subject_research, informed_consent and at_risk_populations are all unpopulated — deliberately, per source_caveats ('No source states whether the dataset is governed as human subjects research, nor describes protections, assent, or guardian consent'). The honesty is exemplary, but the datasheet still lacks any consent basis or vulnerable-population safeguards.
issues_detected.recommendation: Obtain the consent basis (IRB-approved waiver for retrospective records) and pediatric/neonatal protections from the project and populate the fields.

issues_detected.description: is_deidentified names tokenization, imaging de-identification and re-identification-limiting transforms, but no de-identification standard (Safe Harbor / expert determination), no identifier-removal list and no participant_privacy.reidentification_risk; the caveat states no source quantifies residual risk for high-dimensional waveform, imaging and geocoded location data.
issues_detected.recommendation: Name the de-identification standard per modality and state residual re-identification risk, especially for geocoded OMOP Location entities.

issues_detected.description: regulatory_restrictions.confidentiality_level is 'restricted' and every distribution format is controlled-access, but no regulatory determination (HIPAA de-identified vs limited data set, DUA framework) is named; the restrictions entry is a narrative about a 'legal framework' without naming it.
issues_detected.recommendation: Add the HIPAA determination and the DUA framework behind the licensing agreement; populate hipaa_compliant.

issues_detected.description: No DOI or RRID. id 'https://chorus4ai.org/#chorus-dataset' is a fragment minted on the project website, not a persistent dataset identifier; source_caveats confirms no version identifier, DOI, citation or release date appears anywhere in the bundle.
issues_detected.recommendation: Mint a dataset DOI once a release is formalised and record version/release metadata.

issues_detected.description: known_biases is absent while the title claims 'Equitable AI', sampling_strategies claims sampling for 'a balanced and diverse cohort', and future_use_impacts asserts approaches 'to manage privacy and bias'. Bias is asserted as managed without a single identified, categorised or analysed bias; the representativeness_limitation entry (14 academic hospitals) is the nearest content and is not typed as a bias.
issues_detected.recommendation: Populate known_biases with typed entries (selection bias from academic-centre ICU sampling; measurement bias across monitor vendors and sites) and a fairness assessment.

issues_detected.description: collection_timeframes carries the NIH award period 2022-09-01 to 2026-11-30; the record's own caveat states 'The calendar range of the underlying clinical encounters is not stated in any source'. issues_detected.recommendation: Record the clinical encounter window once known; keep the award-period value clearly marked as such.

issues_detected.description: data_governance.committee_contact names Jared Houghtaling while the caveat states no source identifies him as a committee contact (he is one of two access-request contacts) and no formal data access committee is named; accountable_organization (MGH) is likewise inferred from the award, as declared.

strengths: Quantitative, sourced description and purposes with 11 typed instance entries carrying B2AI_TOPIC/B2AI_SUBSTRATE codes and counts wherever the sources give them.
Complete funding and creator metadata with a valid NIH OT2 grant number, RePORTER linkage, and a carefully preserved PI-vs-leadership distinction.

Governance and access documentation a step ahead of sibling reps: confidentiality_level 'restricted', accountable organization, stewardship roles, named access contacts, and a proper lifecycle status with the website banner quarantined in notes.

Exemplary epistemic hygiene: source-tier conflicts, award-period dates, software-vs-dataset licenses, the misspelled contact domain, inferred governance attributions and the deliberate non-population of human-subjects fields are all declared in source_caveats.
weaknesses: No IRB review, consent basis, at_risk_populations or data-protection assessment for retrospective ICU/PICU/NICU records; the ethical_reviews entry describes community focus groups, not an ethics review.
No named license, DUA or regulatory determination (HIPAA status) behind the 'restricted' controlled-access posture, and no prohibited/discouraged uses.
No persistent identifier, version, errata, publisher or repository for a dataset explicitly described as a growing partial release.
No known_biases, no demographic characterisation of the 50,000 admissions, and no missing-data or anomaly documentation.
collection_timeframes carries the NIH award period rather than the clinical encounter window (honestly flagged but still occupying the field).
recommendations: Record the IRB determination (institution, protocol, waiver), informed_consent basis, at_risk_populations entries for children and neonates, and participant_privacy.reidentification_risk with a named de-identification standard per modality.
Name the data licence or DUA and the HIPAA determination in license_and_use_terms/regulatory_restrictions; add prohibited_uses and discouraged_uses.
Mint a dataset DOI, record version and version_access, name the enclave as publisher, and state a release schedule and preservation commitment in updates.
Populate known_biases with typed selection and measurement biases plus a fairness analysis, and add demographic subpopulations (age group, sex, race/ethnicity) with missing-data documentation.

Move the award dates out of collection_timeframes (or mark them as award period only), schematise the program-page URL, and add per-tool versions and repository URLs (OHNLP, UF-Geocoding/DeGauss, chorus-mapping, chorus_waveform).
